# maps: true in the output options compiles cleanly.
# No source-map sidecar is emitted yet (no platform consumes Request.Maps
# until Plan B), but the option must not cause a compile error.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --opt maps=true --out=out main.sngl
exists out/index.html

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    text(value="hello")
}
